dialogues.speaker: Galvaryet
dialogues.text: He's one of those weirdos people often talk about. It's obvious he could leave and get a job, but it's impossible to persuade him to go.

dialogues.speaker: Galvaryet
dialogues.text: It's good that he's able to help us by fixing things. But I always suspect he's up to no good and secretly making more work for us...
